task_instance: Train a scVI model on a small synthetic single-cell RNA-seq AnnData object (raw counts, batch_key) to obtain a batch-corrected latent representation, following references/scrna_integration.md's core workflow (setup_anndata -> SCVI -> train -> get_latent_representation).
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable requires the scvi-tools Python package (and its dependencies scanpy and anndata) to build/train a VAE model (e.g. scvi.model.SCVI). None of these are installed on this workstation (only numpy, pandas, and torch are present). The runtime is air-gapped with no ability to install packages, so scvi-tools/scanpy/anndata cannot be obtained. Without scvi-tools there is no way to run scvi.model.SCVI.setup_anndata/train/get_latent_representation as described in references/scrna_integration.md or scripts/train_model.py, so the actual deliverable (a trained scVI model producing a batch-corrected latent space) cannot be produced or verified.
